cohort: The study included 756 stable term and late preterm neonates born consecutively from January to September 2024 at a tertiary care center.
finding: SGA neonates exhibited significantly higher serum TSH levels at 48-72 hours of life compared to AGA neonates, while FT4 levels were comparable between the groups.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as an independent predictor of higher TSH levels.
cross-section timing: Routine neonatal hypothyroidism screening at 48-72 hours of life
